description: Fanmade campaign by Walker Graves. The first scenario, Late Risers, is playable; later scenarios are pending.

story.intro:
After your stay in St. Mary’s Hospital, you awaken in a morgue beneath a mysterious facility. Green gas seeps under a barricaded door. Your possessions lie nearby. Find a way out.
Campaign by Walker Graves (Dr Jack Science); Spanish translation by Los Archivos de Arkham.
story.setup: Start in the Morgue. Lab Omega is in play with 1 barricade (not per investigator). All other locations, Greyson, First Among Many, Suspicious Briefcase, 2 Agency Troubleshooters and 2 Twisted Supplicants are set aside.
story.hidden: You hear a promise of life beyond death. Serve the voice, and time will bring its reward.
story.reagent: A needle in the briefcase injects a glowing reagent into your hand. Remember that you imbibed a cardinal reagent. The briefcase may pass to another investigator who has not done so.
story.resolution1: You awaken in Hibbs’s Roadhouse. Hibbs dismisses your account of the facility as drunken confusion. The Tailors contained the problem. Gain victory experience; record whether you put out a fire.
story.resolution2: You escape into Hibbs’s Roadhouse and learn the facility’s secret. Gain victory experience. If Greyson is in the victory display, the First claimed the facility. Record whether you put out a fire; keep the briefcase if you escaped with it.
story.resolution3: Greyson escorts you to Hibbs’s Roadhouse and explains the Tailors’ work. You earned her respect and learned the roadhouse’s secret. Gain victory experience, record whether you put out a fire, and keep the briefcase if you escaped with it.
story.prologue: Your investigations left you gravely wounded in St. Mary’s Hospital. Weeks of treatment bring no recovery. As doctors prepare an urgent operation, you glimpse a pair of emerald eyes before everything fades.

note.plaguebearerMotel: The investigators learned the secret of the roadhouse
note.plaguebearerFire: An investigator put out a fire

ability.remove: Spend {amount} clues here: remove {amount} barricades from {location}
ability.fire: Investigate with combat; put out the fire
ability.resign: Return all your clues: resign (2 actions)
ability.hallway: Spend 1 clue: remove up to 3 Tunnel barricades
ability.delta: Increase shroud by 4 to look for another way out
ability.hands: Take 2 damage, discard Idle Hands: gain 1 action
ability.evidenceAuto: End your turn: ignore this token and automatically succeed
ability.briefcaseResources: Exhaust the briefcase, reveal a token: gain 3 resources

prompt.hidden: There is a hidden passage in the prologue. Do you choose to read it?

choice.terror: Discard until a Terror and draw it
choice.hallway: Spend 3 clues per investigator here: reveal the hidden passage
